solutions.title: Add to isolate x
solutions.explanation:
Adding \(\frac34\) to both sides undoes the subtraction from \(x\) while preserving equality. This gives
\[
x=\frac34+\frac5{12}-\frac13.
\]
All three denominators divide \(12\), so write the fractions in twelfths:
\[
x=\frac9{12}+\frac5{12}-\frac4{12}
=\frac{10}{12}
=\frac56.
\]
Therefore, \(x=\boxed{\frac56}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).

solutions.title: Multiply by 12
solutions.explanation:
Multiplying by \(12\) removes all the fractional denominators because \(4\), \(12\), and \(3\) divide \(12\). Multiply every term on both sides by \(12\):
\[
12x-9=5-4=1.
\]
Add \(9\) to both sides to obtain \(12x=10\), then divide both sides by \(12\):
\[
x=\frac{10}{12}=\boxed{\frac56}.
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
